draft.subject: Heavy weather forecast – MV MARRAM STAR – Rotterdam route
draft.body:
Dear Captain,

The new ECMWF IFS forecast run of 20 Jan 00z (available 20 Jan 0800 UTC) indicates heavy weather on your remaining route to Rotterdam from about 21 Jan 15:00 UTC to 23 Jan 18:00 UTC: head wind up to Beaufort 7 (28 kn) with seas on the bow up to 4.6 m.

The office has seen the forecast. The weather routing service's advice and your own judgement come first; the office supports whatever you decide.

Please advise if your ETA changes.

Best wishes for the ship and crew.

Operations
